name: Three of Swords
shortMeaning: Three of Swords speaks of heartbreak, painful truth, and emotional wounds that ask to be acknowledged fully.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Three of Swords says your feelings may still be carrying grief, disappointment, or a truth that hurt when it arrived.
pathMeaning: On your path, Three of Swords points toward honest healing, letting pain move through, and refusing to numb what needs care.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Three of Swords brings a blessing of emotional honesty and the healing that begins when sorrow is faced directly.

name: Four of Swords
shortMeaning: Four of Swords represents rest, recovery, and stepping back so mind and spirit can restore themselves.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Four of Swords says your emotions need peace, quiet, and relief from overstimulation or mental strain.
pathMeaning: On your path, Four of Swords points toward restoration, reflection, and taking a pause before pushing farther.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Four of Swords brings a blessing of stillness, healing rest, and sanctuary for your thoughts.

name: Five of Swords
shortMeaning: Five of Swords highlights conflict, ego clashes, and the cost of battles that leave everyone a little depleted.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Five of Swords says your feelings may be tangled in resentment, defensiveness, or the aftermath of a harsh exchange.
pathMeaning: On your path, Five of Swords points toward choosing your battles wisely and questioning whether winning this way is worth it.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Five of Swords brings a blessing of awareness around conflict and the chance to step out of harmful patterns.

name: Six of Swords
shortMeaning: Six of Swords speaks of transition, leaving turbulence behind, and moving toward calmer waters.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Six of Swords says your emotions are in a process of quiet healing and gradual departure from what has been painful.
pathMeaning: On your path, Six of Swords points toward steady progress, emotional distance from turmoil, and wiser ground ahead.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Six of Swords brings a blessing of passage, protection, and peace returning little by little.

name: Seven of Swords
shortMeaning: Seven of Swords represents strategy, discretion, and the need to think carefully about motives, honesty, and self-protection.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Seven of Swords says your feelings may be wary, private, or alert to where trust has become complicated.
pathMeaning: On your path, Seven of Swords points toward smart planning, discernment, and avoiding situations where deception drains your energy.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Seven of Swords brings a blessing of cunning, awareness, and the wisdom to move carefully.

name: Eight of Swords
shortMeaning: Eight of Swords speaks of feeling trapped, limited, or mentally bound by fear more than by absolute reality.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Eight of Swords says your emotions may be caught in anxious loops that make possibilities seem smaller than they are.
pathMeaning: On your path, Eight of Swords points toward challenging self-limiting thoughts and recognizing where choice still exists.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Eight of Swords brings a blessing of perspective and the first opening out of a confining mindset.

name: Nine of Swords
shortMeaning: Nine of Swords represents worry, mental distress, and the heaviness of fears that grow louder in the dark.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Nine of Swords says your emotions may be burdened by guilt, fear, or thoughts that need gentleness rather than punishment.
pathMeaning: On your path, Nine of Swords points toward naming what is haunting you, seeking relief, and remembering that not every fear is prophecy.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Nine of Swords brings a blessing of release, support, and light returning to an overburdened mind.

name: Ten of Swords
shortMeaning: Ten of Swords speaks of painful endings, finality, and the harsh clarity that comes when something is truly over.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ten of Swords says your emotions may be finishing a difficult chapter and aching for truth, rest, and release.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ten of Swords points toward closure, surrendering what cannot continue, and letting the ending become the threshold to dawn.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ten of Swords brings a blessing of final release, honest endings, and the first light after the worst has passed.

name: Page of Swords
shortMeaning: Page of Swords represents curiosity, alert thinking, and a restless desire to learn, question, and understand.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Page of Swords says your feelings want clarity and may be studying every detail to figure out what is true.
pathMeaning: On your path, Page of Swords points toward observation, honest questions, and sharpening your understanding before acting.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Page of Swords brings a blessing of mental quickness, clear questions, and revealing insight.

name: Knight of Swords
shortMeaning: Knight of Swords speaks of drive, urgency, and charging toward the truth with intensity and focus.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Knight of Swords says your emotions may be moving fast, pushing for answers, action, or immediate clarity.
pathMeaning: On your path, Knight of Swords points toward bold action, direct communication, and channeling mental force wisely.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Knight of Swords brings a blessing of momentum, bravery, and cutting through delay.

name: Queen of Swords
shortMeaning: Queen of Swords represents discernment, honesty, and wisdom refined through experience and clear sight.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Queen of Swords says your feelings want truth with boundaries, not sentiment that blurs what is real.
pathMeaning: On your path, Queen of Swords points toward sharp judgment, clear communication, and trusting the intelligence you have earned.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Queen of Swords brings a blessing of precision, protection, and beautifully clean clarity.

name: King of Swords
shortMeaning: King of Swords speaks of reason, authority, and making clear, principled decisions with a steady mind.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, King of Swords says your emotions need wisdom, integrity, and enough space to be understood without chaos.
pathMeaning: On your path, King of Swords points toward sound judgment, truth-based leadership, and choices shaped by principle.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, King of Swords brings a blessing of clear thinking, fairness, and decisive intellectual strength.

name: Ace of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Ace of Pentacles signals a grounded new opportunity, practical blessing, or seed of real-world abundance.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ace of Pentacles says your feelings want something steady, tangible, and worth building in the real world.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ace of Pentacles points toward material opportunity, healthy foundations, and saying yes to what can truly grow.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ace of Pentacles brings a blessing of stability, prosperity, and fortunate beginnings with lasting potential.

name: Two of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Two of Pentacles represents balancing priorities, adapting well, and keeping several moving parts in motion.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Two of Pentacles says your emotions may be juggling a lot and asking for flexibility without losing center.
pathMeaning: On your path, Two of Pentacles points toward adjustment, rhythm, and making practical choices that help life stay workable.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Two of Pentacles brings a blessing of adaptability, timing, and graceful motion through change.

name: Three of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Three of Pentacles speaks of teamwork, craftsmanship, and building something strong through shared effort and skill.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Three of Pentacles says your feelings want support, mutual respect, and collaboration that honors what you contribute.
pathMeaning: On your path, Three of Pentacles points toward cooperation, learning, and steady progress made with others or with careful practice.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Three of Pentacles brings a blessing of helpful allies, solid work, and visible improvement.

name: Four of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Four of Pentacles represents security, holding on, and the tension between stability and fear of loss.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Four of Pentacles says your feelings may be protective, cautious, or afraid to loosen their grip.
pathMeaning: On your path, Four of Pentacles points toward wise stewardship while also asking where control has become too rigid.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Four of Pentacles brings a blessing of stability and the wisdom to protect what matters without shutting life out.

name: Five of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Five of Pentacles speaks of hardship, scarcity, and feeling unsupported, yet help may be closer than it first appears.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Five of Pentacles says your emotions may be carrying loneliness, worry, or the ache of not feeling resourced enough.
pathMeaning: On your path, Five of Pentacles points toward asking for help, staying connected, and remembering that lack is not the whole story.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Five of Pentacles brings a blessing of resilience, compassion, and support arriving through difficult weather.

name: Six of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Six of Pentacles represents generosity, exchange, and the balance between giving, receiving, and fairness.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Six of Pentacles says your feelings are noticing where care is mutual and where the scales have been uneven.
pathMeaning: On your path, Six of Pentacles points toward support, reciprocity, and practical help that restores balance.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Six of Pentacles brings a blessing of kindness, assistance, and resources flowing more fairly.

name: Seven of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Seven of Pentacles speaks of patience, assessment, and trusting the slow growth of what has already been planted.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Seven of Pentacles says your feelings may be wondering if the effort is worth it, yet growth is happening even now.
pathMeaning: On your path, Seven of Pentacles points toward long-term thinking, evaluation, and allowing time to do part of the work.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Seven of Pentacles brings a blessing of fruitful timing, steady growth, and perspective on what is maturing.

name: Eight of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Eight of Pentacles represents dedication, craftsmanship, and the steady refinement that turns effort into mastery.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Eight of Pentacles says your feelings want focused care and the satisfaction of improving something meaningful.
pathMeaning: On your path, Eight of Pentacles points toward practice, skill-building, and trusting disciplined repetition to pay off.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Eight of Pentacles brings a blessing of concentration, progress, and pride in well-made work.

name: Nine of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Nine of Pentacles speaks of self-sufficiency, refinement, and enjoying the rewards of what you have patiently cultivated.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Nine of Pentacles says your feelings want independence, peace, and the pleasure of knowing you have built something good.
pathMeaning: On your path, Nine of Pentacles points toward confidence, self-trust, and savoring the abundance that comes from steady effort.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Nine of Pentacles brings a blessing of comfort, elegance, and well-earned prosperity.

name: Ten of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Ten of Pentacles represents legacy, lasting security, and the wealth of what endures across time, family, or community.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ten of Pentacles says your feelings want roots, continuity, and a future that feels truly supported.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ten of Pentacles points toward long-term stability, inheritance of wisdom, and building something meant to last.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ten of Pentacles brings a blessing of stability, generational support, and enduring abundance.

name: Page of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Page of Pentacles speaks of study, practical opportunity, and the early stages of building something solid and valuable.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Page of Pentacles says your feelings are ready to invest in what is real, useful, and capable of growing well.
pathMeaning: On your path, Page of Pentacles points toward learning, grounded ambition, and taking small concrete steps that matter.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Page of Pentacles brings a blessing of steady beginnings, helpful lessons, and promising real-world potential.

name: Knight of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Knight of Pentacles represents diligence, reliability, and consistent effort that values substance over speed.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Knight of Pentacles says your feelings want steadiness, loyalty, and proof that care can be dependable.
pathMeaning: On your path, Knight of Pentacles points toward patience, routine, and making real progress through faithful daily effort.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Knight of Pentacles brings a blessing of endurance, reliability, and slow success that holds.

name: Queen of Pentacles
shortMeaning: Queen of Pentacles speaks of practical nurture, grounded abundance, and caring for life in ways that are both loving and effective.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Queen of Pentacles says your feelings want comfort, stability, and a way of caring that supports real wellbeing.
pathMeaning: On your path, Queen of Pentacles points toward wise stewardship, embodied self-care, and creating beauty that is also useful.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Queen of Pentacles brings a blessing of warmth, prosperity, and earthy, dependable support.

name: King of Pentacles
shortMeaning: King of Pentacles represents abundance, mastery of the material world, and leadership that creates lasting security.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, King of Pentacles says your feelings want reliability, maturity, and a life that feels well-supported and real.
pathMeaning: On your path, King of Pentacles points toward success, wise management, and building prosperity with patience and integrity.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, King of Pentacles brings a blessing of stability, material blessing, and confident grounded leadership.
